_about: Sources LightSim never takes data from, not even to check a value by hand
(docs/DATA-REGISTER.md, rule 3; CON-31). This file is the one list:
- backend/tests/test_data_register.py fails when a row of
docs/data-register.csv, or a source in the reference suite
(backend/validation/), names one ('match': lower-case text looked for in
the source), and when rule 3 of DATA-REGISTER.md leaves one out ('name');
is generated from it (python -m app.ai.skillpack --write in backend/), so an
assistant never suggests data from these; a test fails when it is stale.
Users may still import such data themselves into their own projects (CON-34);
LightSim does not ship it. Adding or removing a source is a licensing

sources.name: the UNECE website
sources.why: its terms forbid reuse without written permission
sources.instead: the EU's copy of the same regulation on EUR-Lex (Decision 2011/833/EU)

sources.name: ev-database.org
sources.why: prior permission and manual copying only
sources.instead: OpenEV Data (CDLA-Permissive-2.0), the EEA's CO2 monitoring data (CC-BY-4.0) or fueleconomy.gov, with credit

sources.name: the gaia-charge/evdb database
sources.why: CC BY-SA 4.0, whose share-alike terms would reach the data built on it

sources.name: JRC `wltp`
sources.instead: the WLTC as Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 gives it on EUR-Lex (LightSim ships it)

sources.name: the TUM racetrack database
sources.instead: a track the user measures or draws, or the layouts LightSim ships

sources.name: China's CLTC (GB/T 38146.1-2019)
sources.why: a standard sold by its publisher
sources.instead: the user's own copy, imported into their project as a cycle of their own

sources.name: Artemis
sources.why: its traces have no clear terms
sources.instead: the user's own copy, imported into their project as a cycle of their own
